edits.note: Tony: move the whole-inbox features to wave B, because once the whole inbox is read the school digest is trivial; and use gog as the connector.

set.name: Read-only Gmail for each parent through gog's MCP server (a token, no password): a 07:00 digest of the whole inbox and 'did I get an email about X?'
set.description: Each parent approves read-only access to their own Gmail once, on Google's consent screen; Google issues a token that stays on the Mac mini, and Happy never holds a password. One locked-down mail agent per adult uses that token through gog's MCP server. All of it ships in wave B: a parent asks 'did the dentist confirm?' and gets the sender, the date and the gist; at 07:00 the agent texts about ten lines on mail that needs a reply, has a deadline or involves money (from January to April a Saturday text adds which expected tax forms have had an arrival email); and the school digest (F051) runs on the same connection. Nothing in Gmail is changed, labelled, drafted or sent, and the agent cannot browse, run code or message anyone but its owner.
